Warning badges now sit on the plant itself, at the top right of its circle, stacked when a plant has more than one, not beside its name. They're drawn over the plants around it, so a taller neighbor no longer covers them.

A bed's or a sun area's name no longer hides under its plants on the plan: where plants cover its middle, the name moves just above the bed (or below or beside it), as it already did in printouts and pictures.
A poison warning you dismissed stays dismissed when fewer are at risk, say the kids are no longer in the yard. It comes back only when someone newly at risk is added.
A plant's details now say when it needs a partner to fruit, with Dismiss and Show again, as Warnings has them.
In Warnings, a kind's “Dismiss all” and “Show all again” are now at the top of its list, above its warnings.
Utilities with none drawn no longer count as a check that can't run: a yard may have no utility lines at all. Its card just says “None drawn”.
Notices and the floating Redo no longer cover the Warnings button, or the top of Warnings when it's open beside the plan.
The Warnings count now changes as you drag a sun area's hours, with its details still open.
Turning your phone while going through your warnings keeps the plant you're on in view.
